bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to lobbying; prohibiting legislators from lobbying for two years after leaving office; authorizing a civil penalty; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 10A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[10A.035] LOBBYING RESTRICTION. +]

[+A member of the legislature must not act as a lobbyist or register as a lobbyist for a period of two years following the end of the member's legislative service. The board may impose a civil penalty of the lesser of $25,000 or an amount equal to the amount the member earned as a lobbyist in violation of this section. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to legislators who leave legislative service on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to lobbying; prohibiting legislators from lobbying for two years after leaving office; authorizing a civil penalty; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 10A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[10A.035] LOBBYING RESTRICTION.

A member of the legislature must not act as a lobbyist or register as a lobbyist for a period of two years following the end of the member's legislative service. The board may impose a civil penalty of the lesser of $25,000 or an amount equal to the amount the member earned as a lobbyist in violation of this section.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to legislators who leave legislative service on or after that date.
additions: A member of the legislature must not act as a lobbyist or register as a lobbyist for a period of two years following the end of the member's legislative service. The board may impose a civil penalty of the lesser of $25,000 or an amount equal to the amount the member earned as a lobbyist in violation of this section.
This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to legislators who leave legislative service on or after that date.
